title: Veldt
extract:
The Veldt is a Tenno semi-automatic revolver rifle sporting high damage and accuracy, but has a fairly poor fire rate. It also possesses an adjustable zoom via Alternate Fire while aiming.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
While aiming, Alternate Fire adjusts the zoom, allowing players to deal with enemies at close and medium ranges.
Innate  polarity.
Has uniform spread while hip-firing and while scoped, meaning that shots will not stray above or below the reticle.
Advantages over other Primary Semi-Auto Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high magazine size (26)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Above average reload speed (1.80 s)
Very high ammo max (546)
Above average fire rate (3.67 attacks/sec)
High disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x))
Disadvantages over other Primary Semi-Auto Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (22.00%)
Low burst DPS (417.49)
Low damage per shot (113.76)
Low total damage (90)
Below average accuracy (0.25° to 6.00°)
Very low crit multiplier (2.20x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Veldt's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Notes
While aiming, players can increase or decrease the zoom using Alternate Fire.
The pitch of the shots changes on the last 4 rounds.
Unlike most other weapons that have variable zoom modes, (usually auto to semi) the stats of the weapon stay the same, neither punishing nor enhancing the weapon. This means players can choose to have low or high zoom, without suffering any negative (or positive) stat changes in doing so.

Tips
Considering the weapon's alternative fire mode,  Eagle Eye can be used to emulate sniper-grade scope amplification, excluding the scope reticle UI.

Trivia
A Veldt is a thinly forested region typical to the southern part of Africa.
The Veldt shares several similarities with old big game rifles, including the large and ornate trigger guard and hammer, and the full-length rifle "scope".
The Veldt was an offshoot of the  Tenora's design process, which itself came from the  Pandero's design process.
